findings.finding: The first formatter implementation shifted checked HTML body whitespace and its semantic guard correctly rejected the output.
findings.resolution: Preserve exact checked-HTML body bytes while formatting Diamond structure; semantic and idempotence replay passes.

findings.finding: A function result mismatch was initially located at the function declaration rather than the final expression.
findings.resolution: Attribute the result mismatch to the last statement location; single-file and project diagnostics replay at the expression.

findings.finding: The first browser failure label exposed a generated internal handler identifier.
findings.resolution: Separate the qualified internal lookup key from the safe public Component.event label; private server sources remain absent.

findings.finding: The warning-denied all-target Clippy gate found an oversized LSP dispatcher, needless JSON ownership, and panic helpers in the formatter test.
findings.resolution: Split the dispatcher into bounded handlers, borrow response values, and return Result from the test; strict Clippy passes without lint suppression.

findings.finding: The first deterministic-build oracle expected a nonexistent sources.json rather than the implemented private server.json manifest.
findings.resolution: Corrected the frozen harness expectation; product artifacts were unchanged and the two-build comparison passes.

findings.finding: The first cross-engine accessibility oracle assumed aria-describedby contained exactly one ID, while generated controls correctly referenced both description and error IDs.
findings.resolution: Corrected the oracle to require both resolved relationships; all three engines pass.
